fields.Defendant: SALLY BAKSH A/K/A SALLY YABRA, ET ALS.
fields.Plaintiff: WELLS FARGO BANK, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, SUCCESSOR BY MERGER TO WELLS FARGO BANK MINNESOTA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION (FORMERLY KNOWN AS NORWEST BANK MINNESOTA, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION), NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL OR BANKING CAPACITY, BUT SOLELY IN ITS CAPACITY AS TRUSTEE FOR THE MERRILL LYNCH MORTGAGE INVESTORS TRUST, SERIES 2006-WMC1
fields.Property Note:
The property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP OF EDISON in the County of
MIDDLESEX, and the State of New Jersey.
Tax Lot 6, 7 & 8 Block 320
Commonly known as 102 Gracey Street, Edison, New Jersey 08817
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately) 75 x 100 x 75 x 100
Nearest Cross Street: Player Avenue
Subject to Mortgage held by Wells Fargo Bank, National Association, as Trustee for the Holders of the Merrill Lynch Mortgage Investors Trust, Mortgage Loan Asset-Backed Certificates, Series 2006-WMC1 in the amount of $90,000 dated August 11, 2005 and recorded October 5, 2005 in Book 10986, Page 883 within the Clerk's Office of Middlesex County.
The sale is subject to unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water and sewer liens and other
municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority.
Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any
condominium/homeowner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further
subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record.
The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is $797,891.67 calculated through September 25, 2026 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's cost and commission to the date of sale.
